name: Man Infraconstruction Ltd
title: Man Infraconstruction Ltd - 533169 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real estate-led Mumbai developer with no capacity or utilisation data; FY26 revenue flat at ~INR630 crore, sales ~INR1,800 crore, management targets INR5,000 crore presales over FY27-28 and 35-40% revenue growth, with little hard disclosure behind it.

triggers.label: Revenue recognition +35-40% in FY27
triggers.quote: we are expecting nearly around 35% to 40% of growth in terms of revenue recognition

triggers.label: FY27-28 presales target >INR5,000 crore
triggers.quote: set an ambition combined sales target over next 2 years , FY27 and FY28, of over INR5,000 crores

triggers.label: No price appreciation assumed
triggers.quote: we have always taken projects or done the feasibility, we, as MICL, have a policy where we have never considered the price appreciation

triggers.label: Launch timing pushed to festive season
triggers.quote: we are waiting right now where the situation globally, which is changing the sentiments of customers

guidance.metric: Revenue recognition growth FY27 vs FY26
guidance.quote: we are expecting nearly around 35% to 40% of growth in terms of revenue recognition
set an ambition combined sales target over next 2 years , FY27 and FY28, of over INR5,000 crores
we target nothing less than INR2,500 crores for this upcoming year

guidance.value: double to over INR35,000 crore by 2031
guidance.quote: we now aspire to double our development portfolio to over INR35,000 crores of GDV

red_flags.label: Revenue recognition not disclosed project-wise
red_flags.quote: Can you please provide a detailed project-wise reconciliation between cumulative bookings, collections, percentage completion and revenue recognized till date across the projects?

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT driven by other income; interest income on project capital
red_flags.quote: MICL Group earns interest income on the capital invested in its project entities. This must be understood as one of our business incomes

red_flags.label: Repeated refusal to give segment and revenue detail
red_flags.quote: Post this call, you can get in touch with Yashesh for the micro detailed report analysis

red_flags.label: Net worth built on INR1,461 crore project capital
red_flags.quote: cumulatively, MICL Group's investment across these projects stand at around INR1,461 crores

evasions.quote: On the revenue recognition aspect, I would request you that we can help for the details post the con call.
Post this call, you can get in touch with Yashesh for the micro detailed report analysis

evasions.topic: Price appreciation and pricing power by micro-market
evasions.quote: I don't see a price appreciation happening, but a flat line on the price does not depict a flat line on bottom line or top line.
there's no specific number which I can point it out to
